homepage.heroTitle: Where Curiosity Meets Joyful Montessori Excellence
homepage.heroSubtitle: Welcome to Vannam World Preschool — cultivating confident, creative, and compassionate early learners through scientifically rooted play and nurturing spaces.

about.title: Nurturing Little Minds Since 2018
about.subtitle: A modern child-first sanctuary where early childhood science meets boundless playful curiosity.
about.mission: To provide a safe, joyful, and developmentally enriched environment where every child discovers their unique talents through exploratory learning.
about.vision: To become the benchmark for early childhood education, raising resilient, empathetic, and innovative lifelong learners.

values.title: Safety & Love First
values.desc: Every child is cared for with uncompromising safety standards and genuine emotional warmth.

values.title: Holistic 7-Shade Growth
values.desc: Balancing cognitive, sensory, artistic, physical, emotional, and social development.

values.title: Hands-on Montessori Tools
values.desc: Encouraging self-discovery with tactile wooden apparatus and exploratory play kits.

values.title: Parent Partnership
values.desc: Transparent daily communication and collaborative milestone tracking.

programs.title: Toddler Playgroup
programs.desc: Sensory play, social initiation, motor skills stimulation, and language building through gentle songs and movement.
features: Sensory tactile sand and water stations

programs.title: Nursery Explorers
programs.desc: Structured Montessori apparatus exploration, early phonics, numeracy foundations, and creative art studio blocks.

programs.title: Junior Kindergarten (LKG)
programs.desc: Reading readiness, STEAM inquiry science experiments, bilingual story circles, and practical life skills.

programs.title: Senior Kindergarten (UKG)
programs.desc: Advanced reading comprehension, mental arithmetic, collaborative problem-solving, and primary school readiness.

programs.title: Daycare & Extended Care
programs.desc: Nutritious hot meals, supervised nap times, homework support, karate, dance, and free play in a secure, loving space.

facilities.title: Smart Classrooms
facilities.desc: Interactive touch panels, ergonomic child-sized furniture, and anti-glare natural lighting.

facilities.title: Safe Agility Playground
facilities.desc: Imported shock-absorbing rubber turf, padded climbing frames, and shaded sandbox areas.

facilities.title: Montessori & STEAM Lab
facilities.desc: Dedicated tactile learning room equipped with wooden counting rods, gears, and puzzles.

facilities.title: Children's Story Library
facilities.desc: Cozy reading nooks filled with plush cushions, puppet stages, and over 1,200 picture books.

facilities.title: Indoor Soft Play Area
facilities.desc: Temperature-controlled ball pit, foam obstacle blocks, and mini climbing walls.

facilities.title: Organic Dining Kitchen
facilities.desc: Licensed in-house chef preparing fresh, nutritionist-approved warm lunches and snacks daily.
